meta.title: Plugin online updates
meta.description: Check and update eligible plugins while stock DeepSeek Harness stays running. Open Plugin online updates, check all updates, review versions, query sources and replacement conditions, then select and confirm. At most 20 targets per batch; initial opening does not query or select. Wait for tasks to finish naturally by default. Stopping current Agent activities needs separate consent, can clear queued input and cannot undo completed work. External terminals and independent Workers are never killed; DSH is not automatically closed or restarted. Normal npm updates use the official exact-version Host path and retain npm identity. Prepared archives are preflight evidence: the Host downloads again, and installation or recovery is not an atomic exact-byte transaction. Self-update is separate and supports official npm, the fixed public mirror/fallback plan and this repository pinned to a full GitHub commit; sources are not silently migrated. Default registry values are resolved through Host observations. Mirror/fallback archives require canonical npm comparison and extra consent without changing global source settings. npmmirror downloads permit only one exact package/version redirect to its fixed CDN; private, unknown or unverifiable origins remain blocked. JS dependency support is limited to unchanged declarations and verified installed graphs/files without native dependencies or install lifecycle scripts. WSL candidates use public archives and the modern Host declaration contract rather than a fixed version allowlist; original proofs and old resources remain, existing sessions may retain old presets, and generated packages remain local archives. The stock Union Search npm/HMR path does not support safe hot updates: older 0.5.1 only blocked the risk, which is not a fix. A separate reviewed 0.10.24 to 0.10.25 complete-dependency generation requires acknowledgement of the local source, temporary unload and recovery risk; built-in Versions eligibility is not retained. Target updates, restoration, installed files, Host activation and page synchronization are independent observations. Unknown outcomes are not automatically resent; missing proofs or exhausted retention bounds refuse before mutation. The detail extension only checks and navigates, not installs. This plugin does not patch DSH/Node/Electron, elevate, force unlock, terminate user processes or approve scripts/version exemptions. Bounded local diagnostics are not uploaded. Windows x64 only with plugin Node >=24; the read-only file-use helper requires .NET Framework 4.x and execution permission. Verified user npm 0.5.0 to 0.5.3 self-update, WSL 0.26.2 to 0.29.0 and isolated source tests do not prove every device or future release. Second-device, complete real mirror-upgrade, distro task-continuity and full browser interaction coverage remain incomplete.
